sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def npos(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':
            rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return (min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
    return None
prev=current_frame.ascii
print("N before:",npos(current_frame))
r=action(['UP','UP'])
a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n'); b=prev.split('\n')
ch=[(rr,cc,b[rr][cc],a[rr][cc]) for rr in range(64) for cc in range(64) if b[rr][cc]!=a[rr][cc]]
from collections import Counter
print("changes:",len(ch),Counter((x[2],x[3]) for x in ch))
for x in ch[:30]: print("  ",x)
print("N after:",npos(current_frame))
print("done:",r.get('done'),"lc:",r.get('level_completed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
